evidence.quote: Both vaccines induced robust polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody responses against serogroups A and C, as measured by ELISA.
Immune response to Diphtheria toxoid (DT) carrier protein was assessed at Days 0, 7 and 30 using anti- DT IgG capture microsphere assay.

Both vaccines induced a rapid increase in serum bactericidal activity (SBA), which was detectable as early as day 7, peaked at day 30, began to decline by day 180, yet remained substantially above baseline at day 750 ( Fig. 1d ).
Blood ASC were identified by flow cytometry as CD3 neg , CD20 neg , CD38 hi , CD27 hi , CD19 + cells as described previously 56 .
Antigen specific and total IgG, IgM, and IgA secreting cells were quantified by ELISpot.

To gain insights into the molecular mechanisms underlying the responses to meningococcal vaccines, we analyzed the transcriptomic profiles in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC, days 0, 3 and 7) of the vaccinees using DNA microarrays ( Table 1 ).
Consistent with this, analysis of plasma cytokines revealed little change induced by either vaccine ( Supplementary Fig. 3 ).
